comments.overrides.tar: unpdf optionally depends on canvas (for rendering PDFs to images, which we never do) which pulls @mapbox/node-pre-gyp -> tar@6. tar@6 carries critical advisories. We cannot omit optional deps wholesale because Next's SWC platform binaries are optional too, so tar is pinned forward instead. If canvas's native build fails as a result, nothing is lost — it is an optional dep we do not use.
comments.overrides.jose: firebase-admin@14 → jwks-rsa@3 → jose@5+ (ESM-only). Vercel Node runtime crashes at boot with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM when jwks-rsa tries to require() jose. jose@4 still ships CJS, so pinning it here lets jwks-rsa require() work again. Auth still verifies fine — jose@4 has all the JWK/JWT primitives firebase-admin needs.
